tagline.en: Helios — PKU-YuanGroup's Apache-2.0 video model spanning text-, image-, and video-to-video, with long-video chunked generation.
tagline.zh: Helios——北大袁粒团队的 Apache-2.0 视频模型，覆盖文生/图生/视频到视频，并以分块方式生成长视频。

en: Helios is an open-weight video generation model from PKU-YuanGroup, released under Apache-2.0. It handles text-to-video, image-to-video, and video-to-video, and is built for long-video generation.

It comes in three checkpoints: Distilled (the default, efficient route), Base, and Mid. Helios generates in 33-frame chunks and rounds a requested frame count up to a compatible number of chunks, so longer outputs are produced by extending the sequence chunk by chunk. Resident sessions keep the native frame history across chunks and let you update the prompt at chunk boundaries.

In WorldFoundry the default route uses Helios-Distilled and supports all three modes. Runtime options include group offloading and multi-GPU context parallelism for larger runs; checkpoints are downloaded separately.
zh: Helios 是北大袁粒团队开源的视频生成模型，采用 Apache-2.0 许可。它支持文生视频、图生视频与视频到视频，并面向长视频生成。
它提供三个 checkpoint：Distilled（默认的高效路径）、Base 与 Mid。Helios 以 33 帧为一块生成，会把请求的帧数向上取整到兼容的块数，因此较长输出是通过逐块延展序列产生的。常驻会话在多块之间保留原生帧历史，并允许你在块边界更新提示词。
在 WorldFoundry 中，默认路径使用 Helios-Distilled 并支持全部三种模式。运行时选项包括分组卸载（group offloading）与多 GPU 上下文并行，便于更大规模的运行；checkpoint 需单独下载。

whenToUse.en: A strong open-licensed pick when you need multiple video modes in one model and want long-video output built from chunked generation — start with the efficient Distilled route.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要在同一模型里使用多种视频模式，并希望通过分块生成得到长视频时，它是很好的开放许可之选——从高效的 Distilled 路径起步即可。

notFor.en: Frame counts are quantized to 33-frame chunks, so exact arbitrary lengths aren't guaranteed. Helios does not offer interactive keyboard-style camera control. Checkpoints are downloaded separately.
notFor.zh: 帧数会量化到 33 帧的块，因此无法保证任意精确长度。Helios 不提供交互式键盘式相机控制。checkpoint 需单独下载。

en: Apache-2.0 across Distilled, Base, and Mid checkpoints
Text-to-video, image-to-video, and video-to-video in one model
Long-video generation in 33-frame chunks with prompt updates at boundaries
Group offloading and multi-GPU context parallelism as runtime options
zh: Distilled、Base、Mid 三个 checkpoint 均为 Apache-2.0
文生视频、图生视频与视频到视频集于一体
以 33 帧为块生成长视频，可在块边界更新提示词
提供分组卸载与多 GPU 上下文并行等运行时选项
